acceptance: Force a native explain/logical-plan acquisition failure for each capture helper; the benchmark query may still succeed in non-strict mode, but the result and persisted bundle report capture failure with the original cause and do not count the error wrapper as a captured plan.

A failed capture is not hidden by another successful stream/phase variant of the same query ID; define and consistently apply capture identity/count semantics without changing ordinary repeated-query deduplication accidentally.
Adapter reuse resets capture error/warning state per run, and configured strict behavior is respected without double-executing the benchmark query.
Regression tests cover helper-caught exceptions through actual profiling, mixin processing, statistics and serialization rather than only exceptions thrown outside the helper.
context:
Source-backed defect hypothesis from 2026-10-28; reproduce before changing. Prior completed qpc-15 addressed error persistence/reset generally; this item targets caught helper errors retained as non-None plan objects and same-ID masking.

Guardrails: the measured query must still succeed in non-strict mode; never re-execute a query to recover a plan; reuse the existing plan_capture_error row field / adapter plan_capture_errors / compute_plan_capture_stats(existing_errors=...) channel rather than adding a new one. Do not change SQL capture accounting semantics except where the shared stats function is corrected for both paths, and test SQL counts are unchanged.

Verification rubric: (1) focused regression test fails before the change and passes after; (2) uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 on the touched plan test modules passes; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff/typecheck on touched files pass; (4) a runtime smoke on the real surface described in acceptance is recorded in the PR body.
description: capture_polars_plan, capture_datafusion_plan and capture_pyspark_plan catch exceptions and return a truthy QueryPlan(plan_type="error"). _structure_dataframe_plan explicitly retains error wrappers. compute_plan_capture_stats treats any non-None query_plan as captured, so these acquisition failures can appear as successful captures and their cause can bypass the existing error channel. ID-only set accounting can also mask a failed variant when another execution of the same query ID has a plan. Verify these paths and route genuine failures through the existing persisted error contract.
